messages:
Sam: Pager: Hosted API p50 jumped ~500ms and a few customers report 504s. Error spike correlates with higher queue depth. Investigating now, paging ENG-ONCALL.
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered by latency_slo_alert (p50>300ms) on service=hosted-api, region=us-west. Incident ID: INC-241987. Paging @Sam @Maya @Eli.
Maya: On it. Any recent deploys?
Deploy Bot: Deploy completed: service/hosted-api @release/2026-03-15-1 by ci-user at 2419876200. Rolling back available.
Eli: I see sustained queue length increase on runtime pool gpu-infer-2, inflight per shard=380 -> baseline 250. Timeouts climbing. Logs show async-kv hits are fine.
Sam: Good catch. Hypothesis: recent change to batching logic increased max_inflight defaults. We should temporarily tighten in-flight and start shedding to protect latency for paying tiers. Plan: 1) set max_inflight=220 2) set shedding_ratio=0.35 for best-effort queues 3) reduce request timeout to 12s from 20s 4) disable streaming for free-tier routes. Can someone push the changes and monitor?
Eli: I can change runtime flags via config service. Pushing a canary to us-west-1 first.
Eli: Command I'm using: ```
curl -X POST https://config.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"service":"hosted-api","region":"us-west-1","overrides": {"runtime.max_inflight":220,"runtime.shed_ratio":0.35,"runtime.request_timeout_ms":12000,"features.streaming_free":false}}'
```
Sam: :thumbsup: Start canary and leave 10% traffic. Notify when metrics show p50 back under 300ms or error rates improve.
Infra Runner: Canary rollout initiated: 10% traffic -> gpu-infer-2a. Change id cfg-241987-1.
Maya: Noted customer impact: Nina-CS, do we have known paying customers on free-tier affected?
Nina-CS: Yeah, two trial accounts reported 504s (acct: trial-1023, trial-2048). Both are low priority but need communication if outage persists.
Eli: Canary metrics after 2m: p50 on canary = 180ms, error rate down 65% on that cohort. Overall p50 for us-west still ~320ms (mix includes other nodes). Rolling canary to 50% now.
Sam: Good. While we ramp, let's also apply emergency rate-limits for anonymous/free keys: set rl.requests_per_min=60 to reduce burst.
Maya: I'll update the quota table in edge-proxy. Patch: ```
PATCH /edge/v1/quotas/free-keys
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "requests_per_min": 60,
  "burst": 20
}
```
Infra Runner: Quota patch applied globally at 2419876660.
Eli: Rolling out to 100% now. Metrics: p50(us-west) -> 195ms, total 504s reduced by 78%.
Sam: Great. Can we keep the tightened max_inflight and shed_ratio for 2 hours then reassess? Also file a follow-up to revert streaming flag after we confirm stable.
Maya: Agreed. I'll own the post-incident ticket and customer comms. @Nina-CS please prepare a short note for the two trials once we confirm full remediation.
Nina-CS: Will draft and ping for approval.
Deploy Bot: cfg-241987-1 verified. No rollbacks triggered.
Oncall Bot: Incident INC-241987 -> mitigation applied. Current status: partial mitigation; monitoring. Next update in 15m or on major state change.
Eli: Logging the exact changes in runbook: `max_inflight=220, shed_ratio=0.35, request_timeout_ms=12000, streaming_free=false, free_quota_rpm=60`. Will add perf graphs to the ticket.
Sam: Handing off to Maya for 2h watch. If anything regresses, page primary oncall. Thanks team :heart:
